content:
It

[Verse 1]
[Bb]started out as a fee-
[F]ling Which then grew
[Gm]into a hope
[Eb]Which then turned
[Bb]into a
[F]quiet thought Which then turned
[Gm]into a quiet word
[Eb]And

[Pre-Chorus]
[F]then that word grew [Gm]lou-
[F]der and louder
[Bb]'Til it was a [F]battle cry
[Gm]I'll come back

[Chorus]
[Eb]when you
[F]call [Bb]me
[Gm]No need to say goodbye
[F]

[Verse 2]
[Bb]Just because everything's chan-
[F]ging Doesn't mean it's ne-
[Gm]ver been this way before
[Eb]
[Bb]All you can do is try to know
[F]who your friends are As
[Gm]you head off to the war
[Eb]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F]Pick a star on [Gm]the dark
[F]horizon and
[Bb]follow [F]the light
[Gm]You'll come back

[Chorus]
[Eb]when it's
[Bb][F]over
[Gm]No need to [F]say goodbye
[Eb]You'll come back
when it's
[Bb][F]over
[Gm]No need to [F]say goodbye

[Eb]
[Gm]
[Ab]

[Verse 3]
[Bb]Now we're back to the be-
[F]ginning It's just a fee-
[Gm]ling and no one knows
[Eb]yet But
[Bb]just because they can't feel
[F]it too Doesn't mean
[Gm]that you have to forget
[Eb]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F]Let your memories [Gm]grow stron-
[F]ger and stronger
[Bb]'Til they're before [F]your eyes
[Gm]You'll come back

[Chorus]
[Eb]when they
[F]call [Bb]you
[Gm]No need to [F]say goodbye
[Eb]You'll come back
when they
